{{Quote|Jedi, come with us.|Talia, to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Witches of the Mist">{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}}</ref>}}
'''Talia''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] and a member of [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin's]] [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]].

==Biography==
[[File:WelcomeHomeAsajj-Nightsisters.png|thumb|left|250px|Talia and her sisters confront a newly returned Asajj Ventress]]
Talia was a member of [[Clan mother/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin's]] coven of [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] witches on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she and several of her fellow sisters confronted the wounded [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], a former Nightsister who had been betrayed by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. She, along with the other members of her clan, prepared to execute Ventress, only to be stopped by Talzin, who informed them that Ventress was one of their own. Soon afterward, Talia helped prepare the [[Water of Life/Legends|Water of Life]] to revive Ventress. She also helped prepare an invisibility [[Magic/Legends|magic]] potion for Ventress and her fellow Nightsisters [[Karis/Legends|Karis]] and [[Naa'leth/Legends|Naa'leth]] to use in an infiltration of [[Dooku's palace/Legends|Count Dooku's palace]]. After this attempt failed, she was present when Ventress and her sisters returned in their [[Raider (salvage freighter)/Legends|ship]].<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Nightsisters">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode312.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Nightsisters}}</ref>

Talia attended Count Dooku's arrival at the [[Nightsister fortress]]. Some time later, Talia, Karis, Talzin, and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] used a [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|Sheathipede-class transport shuttle]] to travel to Dooku's palace on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] to deliver Savage to Dooku as a replacement apprentice. The three Nightsisters then returned to Dathomir.<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Monster">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode313.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Monster}}</ref>

When Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi arrived at the Nightsister fortress looking for a lead on the location of Savage Opress, Talia and other members of her clan descended from above the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], disarmed them, and brought them to Mother Talzin. She was later present when the wounded Savage Opress returned to Dathomir following his battle with Dooku, Ventress, and the two Jedi above [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]].<ref name="EG:WotM">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode314.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Witches of the Mist}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Talia was voiced by [[Angelique Perrin]], who also voiced [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]].<ref name="EG:WotM" />
